items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: George Calder, saxophone novelties. Stuart Bergen and his hot trumpet

ctx.x: Blackout. She was a singer, huh?

Yeah. That's 1936. She did sing. Oh, they have Tom Brown and his talking bass on the right arm. Yeah. George Calder, saxophone novelties. Stuart Bergen and his hot trumpet, Clarence Nunn guitar. Morris Esquiat piano wizard. The bar barrel was strictly commercial, wasn't it? Yeah. Ten or six piece orchestras as desired. Here's the band with Harry Shields and Gene Emott and John Wall.
Didn't Greenwood take one of them pictures of both of them?
